content.description: Andreessen Horowitz, commonly known as a16z, is a venture capital firm backing bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, the firm invests from seed to late-stage in technology companies across bio and healthcare, consumer, crypto, enterprise, fintech, games, and firms pursuing American dynamism. a16z manages about $35 billion in assets across multiple funds.
